overview: In 16th century Shingly (Kochi, Kerala) Kabbalist Nehemiah Ben Abraham Mota was rumoured to have the power of levitation. This film assembles the ruinous remnants of the places where these and other miracles occurred.  His legacy are a series of wedding songs precariously assembled and archived, danced to by an interfaith following who worship him as a village deity.  Using celluloid processed by hand, wedding songs is a collaboration with Mota’s light and the body of the film.
tagline: as you flee your body  reunited with your beloved  drifting, rebuilding worlds together  returning to that distance  that emerged during the final days  of these wedding songs
title: wedding songs
